parameters.name: CidrBlock
parameters.description:
The CIDR block of the vSwitch. Take note of the following requirements: 

- The mask length of the vSwitch CIDR block must be 16 to 29 bits.  

- The CIDR block of the vSwitch must fall within the CIDR block of the VPC to which the vSwitch belongs. 

- The CIDR block of the vSwitch cannot be the same as the destination CIDR block of a route entry in the VPC, but can be a subset of the destination CIDR block. 

- The CIDR block of the vSwitch cannot be within the following reserved address ranges: 100.64.0.0/10, 127.0.0.0/8, 169.254.0.0/16, or 224.0.0.0/4.

> After a vSwitch is created, you cannot modify its CIDR block.

parameters.name: CidrMask
parameters.description:
The IPv4 subnet mask of the vSwitch.
> The mask length of the vSwitch IPv4 CIDR block must be 16 to 29 bits. You must specify at least one of CidrBlock and CidrMask.

parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters.

> If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the **RequestId** of the API request as the **ClientToken**. The **RequestId** may be different for each API request.

parameters.name: Description
parameters.description:
The description of the vSwitch.  

The description must be 1 to 256 characters in length and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`.

parameters.name: Ipv6CidrBlock
parameters.description:
The last 8 bits of the IPv6 CIDR block of the vSwitch. Valid values: **0** to **255**.
You can specify this parameter only when the VPC to which the vSwitch belongs has IPv6 enabled. You can use this parameter to assign an IPv6 CIDR block to the vSwitch. After the IPv6 CIDR block is allocated, it cannot be changed to another CIDR block. Make sure that the CIDR block does not overlap with those of other vSwitches in the VPC.

parameters.name: Ipv6CidrMask
parameters.description:
The IPv6 subnet mask of the vSwitch. You can specify this parameter only when the VPC to which the vSwitch belongs has IPv6 enabled.

> Only 64 is supported.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region ID of the vSwitch that you want to create.

You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~36063~~) operation to query the region ID.

sub_parameters.name: Key
sub_parameters.description:
The tag key of the resource. You can specify up to 20 tag keys. The tag key cannot be an empty string.

A tag key can be up to 128 characters in length. It cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:` and cannot contain `http://` or `https://`.

sub_parameters.name: Value
sub_parameters.description:
The tag value of the resource. You can specify up to 20 tag values. The tag value can be an empty string.

The tag value can be up to 128 characters in length. It cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:` and cannot contain `http://` or `https://`.

parameters.name: VSwitchName
parameters.description:
The name of the vSwitch. 

The name must be 1 to 128 characters in length and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`.

parameters.name: VpcId
parameters.description: The ID of the VPC to which the vSwitch belongs.

parameters.name: VpcIpv6CidrBlock
parameters.description: The IPv6 CIDR block of the VPC. If the VPC to which the vSwitch belongs has multiple IPv6 CIDR blocks, you can specify this parameter to determine the IPv6 CIDR block range for the vSwitch. If you do not specify this parameter, the IPv6 CIDR block assigned when IPv6 was enabled for the VPC is used.

parameters.name: ZoneId
parameters.description:
The zone ID of the vSwitch that you want to create.

You can call the [DescribeZones](~~36064~~) operation to query the zone ID.
